compose_config.stdout:
name: vector_benchmark_starter
services:
  postgres:
    cpus: 6
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: benchmark
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: benchmark
      POSTGRES_USER: benchmark
    image: timescale/timescaledb-ha:pg18.4-ts2.29.1-all-oss
    mem_limit: "8589934592"
    networks:
      default: null
    platform: linux/arm64
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 5432
        published: "5433"
        protocol: tcp
    shm_size: "1073741824"
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: pgdata
        target: /home/postgres/pgdata/data
        volume: {}
  qdrant:
    cpus: 6
    image: qdrant/qdrant:v1.18.1
    mem_limit: "8589934592"
    networks:
      default: null
    platform: linux/arm64
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 6333
        published: "6333"
        protocol: tcp
      - mode: ingress
        target: 6334
        published: "6334"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: qdrantdata
        target: /qdrant/storage
        volume: {}
networks:
  default:
    name: vector_benchmark_starter_default
volumes:
  pgdata:
    name: vector_benchmark_starter_pgdata
  qdrantdata:
    name: vector_benchmark_starter_qdrantdata
